card.name: Avoiding the area around the navel
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or "area") right after "around", "from" or "avoid" when the text is about keeping injections away from the navel. It appears in injection-site instructions for the abdomen.

modes.label: Around/from the navel
modes.description: "the" after "around" or "from" in a 2-inch (5 cm) exclusion zone near the navel.
modes.example: The recommended injection site is the abdomen, except for 2 inches (5 cm) around<< the>> navel.

modes.label: The instruction to avoid the area
modes.description: "the" or "area" after "avoid" or "two-inch" in site-selection lists that exclude the navel region.
modes.example: The recommended subcutaneous injection sites include: The thigh Abdomen, except for a two-inch<< area>> right around the navel

card.writes: It promotes words meaning excluded, prohibited or forbidden, which fits text that names a zone to stay away from.
card.plain: It responds to injection-site text where the navel is about to be named as a spot to avoid.
